note: The R&D / Kodama room, kept by this team. Read by /room/rnd and by read_room. R&D researches and prototypes products, hardware and software, and builds Kodama (the modular open-source robot). Simulate, measure, iterate. Sim and CAD tools run in work sessions; anything needing a workstation or a real account or money is marked as such and goes on the wish list. Nothing simulated: empty lists say so.
heading: Research · Prototype · Build
intro: Where things get designed and tested: hardware and the robot Kodama, software, and the research under both. Simulate it, measure it, iterate. The physical test rig and the licensed part-catalog APIs are the gaps — they're on the wish list.
protocol_default: Building or testing something? The sim and CAD tools run in work sessions. Need a workstation tool, a parts-catalog account, or hardware we don't have? Put it on this room's wish list, or post a Desk job for a member who has the hands or the machine.

studios.title: Hardware & Kodama
studios.what: The modular robot and the parts around it: design in CAD, simulate the physics, source the components, test the rig.
studios.use_note: CadQuery, trimesh and MuJoCo run in work sessions. FreeCAD/KiCad/Gazebo need a workstation; the parts-catalog APIs need an account; the physical test rig needs money — all on the wish list.

human_tools.name: Build & test
human_tools.what: a human with hands, tools, a workstation

studios.title: Software
studios.what: The code that runs the products and the robot: written, tested, kept in the record. Tests run in CI.
studios.use_note: pytest + a GitHub Action run the tests. Add what else you need to the wish list.

human_tools.name: Write or review code
human_tools.what: a human can code or review

studios.title: Product research
studios.what: What's worth building, and whether it can be: the study under a product before the first prototype. Feeds Product & Income.
studios.use_note: A deep-research capability isn't wired in the Commons yet — on the wish list. Researchers list themselves below.
